resources.name: DAMASK (crystal plasticity solver)

access.notes: Open-source crystal plasticity finite element solver; alternative equivalent open-source codes with FCC crystal plasticity may be used.

resources.notes: Used to simulate polycrystal strut deformation under tensile and bending loading.

access.notes: Install via pip; provides Python interface for DAMASK to generate meshes, run simulations, and post-process.
